ticket.title: Distributed ticket records: one file per ticket, ownership by repository, suite rollup
ticket.description:
Supersedes GB-57, which is Verified while all six of its plan steps are unchecked and its receipt is manual and unscoped. The distributed-ledger design it describes was never delivered: the ten member repositories retired their repo-local ledgers on 2026-11-06 (chore(storypole): retire the legacy repo-local ledger), no member has a ledger today, all 2119 events live at the root, ten ticket_prefix configs are dead, and resolve_governing_store_name has no production caller.

DECISION 2026-11-08: keep per-repository ownership, change the storage from one append-only ledger per repository to one file per ticket (.gaugeblock/storypole/tickets/KEY.json holding ticket, ordered events, and external mapping). Why: per-file merge granularity lets two branches touch different tickets without conflict; an ownership move becomes a file move instead of log surgery; the external-tracker mapping commits with the ticket it describes; and a worktree-local file lets a ticket change ride the branch that made it, which is what parallel agent work needs.

RULES: a ticket exists in exactly one file; its owner is fixed by scope.repo; a key prefix is a minting convention and never an owner (GB-17 lives in benchwork with a GB- key); cross-repo links are edges carrying the target uuid plus a repo:key locator and are never copies of the target; tracked source follows the branch, derived state follows the checkout. ADRs 0009 and 0010.
acceptance_criteria: ADR 0009 and 0010 accepted; two worktrees and two agents on one repository lose no update; differential replay of migrated ticket files equals replay of the archived ledger
